title: QUIZ - 84
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Determine whether a function's formula is quadratic
questions.question: Is \( g(t) = 6t + -6 \) a quadratic function?

options.label: A
options.text: Yes, because the variable is raised to the second power.

options.label: B
options.text: It cannot be determined without a graph.

options.label: C
options.text: No, because the variable is not raised to the second power.

options.label: D
options.text: It is quadratic only when b = 0.

questions.explanation: This formula has no squared term, so it does not match the quadratic form ax^2 + bx + c.
questions.hint: A quadratic function must include a term where the variable is squared.

questions.learningObjective: Determine whether a parabola opens upward or downward from its leading coefficient
questions.question: For the quadratic function \( h(n) = -6n^2 + 3n + -10 \), does the parabola open upward or downward?

options.label: A
options.text: This cannot be determined without a graph.

options.label: B
options.text: It opens sideways, because of the linear term.

options.label: C
options.text: Upward, because the leading coefficient is positive.

options.label: D
options.text: Downward, because the leading coefficient is negative.

questions.explanation: The leading coefficient (the coefficient of n^2) is -6, which is negative, so the parabola opens downward.
questions.hint: The sign of the coefficient in front of the squared term determines whether the parabola opens upward (positive) or downward (negative).
